title: Matrix column sum formula
statement: Let $H$ be an $m\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$, let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $i\in\{1,,\ldots,m\}$. The $i$th coordinate of the sum of the columns of $H$ indexed by $S$ is $\sum_{j\in S}H_{ij}$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is an $m\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$
$S$ is a set of column indices
